originalTitle: 'I don't even know if my parents are alive' - the war heroes jailed 25 years ago
title: Children Miss Their Parents So Much!
content:
Hello, super friends! It's me, your kid-friendly reporter from sunny Africa! Today, I have a story that might make your heart feel a little soft. It's about some children, just like you, who live in a country called Eritrea. Eritrea is a beautiful country right here in Africa, with amazing landscapes and friendly people. But these children are very sad. They miss their mummies and daddies so, so much.

A Sad Story from Long Ago

Imagine waking up every day and not knowing where your mum or dad is. That's how these children feel. Their parents disappeared a very, very long time ago. Can you guess how long? It was 25 years ago! Wow, that's even before you were born, and maybe even before your big brother or sister was born! A lot of things can happen in 25 years, right? These children were very small back then, or some weren't even born yet. They have grown up without their parents. They don't know if their parents are safe. They don't know if their parents are happy. They just don't know anything, and that makes them very, very sad. Did you know? Eritrea is a country in East Africa. It has a long coast along the Red Sea, which is full of amazing fish! Its capital city is Asmara, and it's famous for its beautiful old buildings.

Who Were Their Parents?

So, who were these grown-ups who went away? These parents were very important people in their country, Eritrea. They were like the country's helpers. They had big jobs where they tried to make Eritrea a better place for everyone. They were like important leaders or people who spoke up for what they believed was right. They worked hard for their country. They wanted their country to be strong and happy. But one day, 25 years ago, something happened. These important parents were taken away. They were put into a place called 'jail' or 'prison'. What is 'jail'? Imagine a place with strong walls and locked doors where grown-ups go if there's a problem or if rules are broken. It's not a nice place, and usually, people don't want to be there.

25 Years is a Very Long Time!

Twenty-five years is a super, super long time, isn't it? Let's think about it. If you are 7 years old now, 25 years ago, you weren't even a tiny baby yet! Your parents might have been young grown-ups. Your grandparents might have been a bit younger too. Imagine celebrating 25 birthdays without your mum or dad. Imagine 25 Christmases or Eid celebrations or just 25 normal days when you wished you could tell your mum about your day at school, or your dad about your new toy. That's a lot of wishing and waiting for these children. They have grown into big boys and girls, even young grown-ups themselves, but they still remember their parents, or they have only heard stories about them. And they still feel that big empty space in their hearts. Did you know? It's a special right for every child to know who their parents are and to be with them! This is written in big, important rules that countries around the world try to follow.

Why Do They Want Answers So Much?

The children are not just sad; they are also confused. They have many, many questions. They ask: 'Where are our parents?' 'Are they okay?' 'Are they safe?' 'Will we ever see them again?' 'Why did this happen?' They don't know the answers to these big questions. And not knowing is very, very hard. It's like trying to finish a puzzle when you're missing all the most important pieces. You just can't see the full picture. They just want someone to tell them what happened. They want to know if their parents are alive or if they have passed away. This is very important for them to be able to understand their past and to feel a little bit of peace in their hearts. Did you know? When someone is 'missing,' it means no one knows where they are. It's very important to try and find missing people, especially when their families are worried!

Children Need Their Parents' Love

Every child needs their parents. Parents teach us, they play with us, they hug us when we are sad, and they tell us stories. They make us feel safe and loved. These children in Eritrea have missed out on so much of this special love and guidance. They have grown up helping each other, sometimes with aunties, uncles, or grandparents. But nothing can fully replace a mum or a dad. They carry this sadness with them every single day. They often wonder what their parents would be like now. Would they be proud? Would they give the best advice? These thoughts fill their minds and their hearts. Their love for their parents is still very strong, even after all these years. Did you know? Families are like super teams! When families are together, they are stronger and happier. It's important for everyone to have a family who loves them.

A Wish for Hope and Truth

These children are not giving up hope. They are brave. They speak out because they want the world to hear their story. They want people to help them find out the truth about what happened to their parents 25 years ago. They wish that one day, someone will give them the answers they need. Even if the news is hard, knowing the truth can help them heal their hearts. It can help them finally know what happened to the people they love so much. We, as friendly reporters, share their story because we believe everyone deserves to know the truth. We hope that sharing this story can bring a little light and attention to these children and their very important wish. So, let's send a big wish from all of us here in Africa to these brave children in Eritrea. A wish for truth, for answers, and for peace in their hearts.
summary: Children in Eritrea are very sad because their important parents disappeared 25 years ago and they don't know what happened to them, so they want answers.
whyMatters: It matters because every child needs to know about their parents, and not knowing where they are makes children very sad and confused for a very long time.

originalTitle: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
title: Let's All Be Kind and Keep Everyone Safe!
content:
Hello, Friends! From Sunny Africa!

Hello, everyone! It's your friendly reporter here, bringing you news from our amazing home, Africa! I hope you are all having a super day, playing and learning. We live in a big, beautiful country called South Africa. It has sunny skies, pretty flowers, and lots of friendly people. It's a place where we all want to feel happy and safe.

A Little Bit of Sad News

Sometimes, even in the nicest places, sad things happen. We want to talk about something important today. It's about making sure everyone feels loved and protected. We heard some sad news recently. Some people, especially women, have been hurt. This makes many people feel very sad and worried. We all wish for everyone to be safe and sound every single day.

Remembering Dineo Motapane

There was a person named Dineo Motapane. She was a woman, just like your mother, sister, or auntie. Something very, very sad happened to Dineo. We remember her today. And we think about her family and friends who are very sad. Dineo is one of the people we are thinking about right now. We want to make sure that no one else gets hurt like this. Did you know? In South Africa, we have many different languages and cultures! But one thing we all share is wanting to take care of each other.

Why Kindness Matters So Much

Being kind is super important! What is kindness? It means being nice to everyone. It means sharing your toys. It means helping a friend who falls down. It means using gentle hands and gentle words. When we are kind, we make the world a much happier place for everyone. Kindness makes people feel good inside. It makes them feel safe and loved. Did you know? A simple smile can make someone's day a lot brighter! Try it today!

Our Amazing Women and Girls

We have so many amazing women and girls in our lives, don't we? Your mom, your grandma, your teacher, your sister, your friends at school. They are all special and important. Women and girls help us learn. They tell us stories. They cook yummy food. They give us big hugs. They are strong and clever and kind. We need to make sure they feel super safe and happy all the time. Did you know? Women in Africa do many wonderful things! They are doctors, teachers, scientists, and even presidents!

What Does "Being Safe" Mean?

Being safe means you feel good. It means you are not scared. It means no one is hurting you with their hands or with mean words. It means you know that adults are looking out for you. When you are safe, you can play and laugh and learn without worrying. Everyone deserves to feel safe, every single day, no matter where they are. We want our mothers, sisters, and all women to feel safe at home, at work, and everywhere they go. Did you know? If you ever feel unsafe or scared, it's very important to tell a trusted adult right away! An adult can help you.

Working Together to Keep Everyone Safe

Many grown-ups are working very hard right now. They want to make sure that everyone, especially women and girls, is safe from harm. The police are working hard. Our leaders are working hard. Parents and teachers are working hard. They are all trying to find ways to stop sad things from happening. They want to make sure everyone is treated with respect and kindness. They want our communities to be places where everyone feels protected and loved. Did you know? In South Africa, we have many special places called 'safe houses' where people can go if they feel they are in danger. Adults know about these places.

What YOU Can Do!

Even though you are small, you can do big things! How? By being kind! Be kind to your friends. Be kind to your family. Be kind to your teachers. Never hurt anyone with your hands or with mean words. If you ever see someone being mean to another person, especially to a girl or a woman, tell a grown-up you trust right away. You can tell your mom, your dad, your teacher, or another trusted adult. They will know what to do to help. Did you know? Telling an adult when something is wrong is a very brave thing to do! It helps keep everyone safe.

Let's Make Our World Bright!

Let's all promise to be kind and respectful. Let's make sure our homes and our schools are full of love and laughter. We want everyone in South Africa to feel safe and happy. When we all work together, being kind and caring, we can make our country and our whole world a much better place for everyone, especially for all our wonderful women and girls. Thank you for listening, my friends! See you next time! Did you know? South Africa is famous for its beautiful Big Five animals: lions, leopards, elephants, rhinos, and buffalo! Just like these animals are cared for, we must care for each other too! Remember: kindness is a superpower!
summary: This news talks about the sad situation where some women in South Africa have been hurt, reminding us how important it is for everyone, especially women and girls, to be treated with kindness, respect, and to feel safe.
whyMatters: It matters because everyone deserves to feel safe and happy, and we need to make sure no one gets hurt, especially our mothers, sisters, and all the women in our lives, by being kind and telling a grown-up if something bad happens.

title: Super Friends: Let's Keep Everyone Safe in Our African Home!
content:
Hello, Super Friends!

Hi everyone, it's your friendly news reporter here! I'm so happy to chat with you today from our amazing continent, Africa. We are going to talk about something important. It's about being safe in our towns and villages. Sometimes, sad things happen. But when they do, we all work together to make things better and safer for everyone. We want all our friends, our mamas, our papas, our sisters, and brothers to feel happy and safe when they play outside or walk to the shop.

Sad News from Near Johannesburg

Sometimes, grown-ups in our communities feel very worried. This happened recently in a place near a big city called Johannesburg. Johannesburg is in a country called South Africa. It's a very big and busy city! Some grown-ups, especially women, are feeling very sad and a little scared. This is because some bad people have hurt other people. This makes everyone feel very unhappy. They want the bad things to stop. We all wish for happy and peaceful days. **Did you know?** Johannesburg is one of the biggest cities in Africa! It's sometimes called the "City of Gold" because there used to be a lot of gold found there, glittering like treasure!

Why Are People Upset?

Imagine if your friend was hurt. You would feel very sad, right? Well, that's how many grown-ups are feeling now. They are sad because some women were hurt very badly. This happened more than once. When bad things like this happen many times, it makes everyone feel like they need to do something. They want to make sure that everyone can walk around safely, just like you walk to school with your friends. They want peace for all the families in their neighborhood.

What is a Protest?

When people are very worried or sad about something, and they want everyone to know, they sometimes have a "protest." A protest is like when many people stand together and say, "Enough is enough! We want things to change!" They might hold signs or sing songs. It's their way of telling everyone, especially the people who can help, that they need help. The women near Johannesburg had a protest. They stood up together to say they want to be safe. They want the bad people to stop hurting others and make their community a safe space again. **Did you know?** Protests are a way for people to use their voices together to ask for important changes. It shows how strong a community can be when everyone cares!

Who Are These Brave Women?

These women are just like your mothers, your aunties, or your grandmothers. They are brave and strong! They love their families and their communities. They want to make sure that everyone, especially other women and children, can live without fear. They are standing up for what is right. They are saying, "We deserve to be safe!" It is very important that we listen to their voices. They are speaking for all of us, asking for kindness and protection for everyone in South Africa.

What Are the Police Doing?

When bad things happen, our friends, the police, are there to help. The police are like helpers in uniforms. Their job is to keep everyone safe and to catch bad people. In this sad situation, the police in South Africa have started a "task team." A task team is like a special group of police helpers. They work extra hard together to find out what happened and to find the bad people. They are investigating. "Investigating" means they are looking for clues and trying to solve the mystery of what happened. They want to make sure the bad people cannot hurt anyone else. They are working very, very hard to bring safety back to the community. **Did you know?** Police officers go through special training to learn how to keep people safe and solve crimes. They are brave people who work to protect us!

Being Safe is Important

The police also gave some very important advice to the grown-ups. They said that women in the area, especially in a place called Kempton Park, should try not to walk or run alone. They said this is extra important in places where there are not many people around, or in "isolated areas." This means places that are quiet and might not have many houses or shops nearby. It's like when your parents tell you to hold their hand when you cross the street. It's to keep you safe! We must always listen to important safety tips from grown-ups.

Why is it Better Not to Walk Alone?

When you walk alone, especially in quiet places, it might be easier for bad people to do bad things. But when you walk with a friend, or with a grown-up, there are more eyes to see, and more voices to shout for help if something goes wrong. It's like playing a game with your team; you are stronger together! So, the police want everyone to be strong together. They want people to walk with friends or family members. Being together helps us all to be safer and happier when we are out and about. We can look out for each other. **Did you know?** Walking with a friend or a group makes you feel safer and often is safer! More people mean more protection and more fun!

Let's All Keep Each Other Safe!

This news is a reminder for all of us, even kids, to think about safety. When you are playing outside, it's always good to have a friend with you. If you ever feel scared or see something that doesn't look right, what should you do? Tell a grown-up you trust right away! It could be your mom, your dad, your teacher, or another trusted grown-up. They are there to help you and keep you safe. We need to look out for each other in our community. Let's make sure our friends are okay and always play in safe places.

Our Wonderful South Africa

South Africa is a beautiful country with amazing people. Even when sad things happen, the people of South Africa are strong. They come together to help each other. The women protesting are showing us how strong and caring our communities are. They want to make their home, and our African home, a place where everyone feels safe and happy. We are all part of this big family! Let's remember to be kind to each other and always try to help. We are stronger when we are united. **Did you know?** South Africa has 11 official languages! That's a lot of ways to say hello! Like "Sawubona" in Zulu or "Molo" in Xhosa. Imagine learning so many new words!

Remember These Safety Tips!

Let's remember some important things to keep ourselves and our friends safe: * Always try to walk with a friend or a grown-up, never alone if you can help it. * Tell a trusted grown-up if you feel scared or see something strange – your voice is important! * Play in places where there are other people around, where friends can see you. * Know your way home and always tell your grown-ups where you are going before you leave.

Let's All Help!

Together, we can make our communities even safer and happier. We can all be super helpers by following safety rules and looking out for one another. Let's make sure everyone in our African home feels loved and protected. We are strong together! Thank you for listening, super friends!
summary: Brave women near Johannesburg in South Africa are protesting because they want everyone to be safe after some sad things happened, and the police are working hard to help.
whyMatters: It is important because everyone deserves to feel safe and happy in their homes and communities, and we must all help each other to make that happen.

title: News from Far Away: Talking is Best!
content:
Hello, amazing friends! It's your kid-friendly news reporter here, bringing you important news from around our big, beautiful world. Today, we are going to talk about something happening very far away, but it's important to understand. It's about two big countries and how they are trying to solve a problem.

What's Happening Far Away?

Imagine you have two friends, and sometimes friends can have a little disagreement, right? They might not agree on how to play a game, or whose turn it is. Well, something a bit like that is happening with two very big countries. One country is called Iran, and the other is the United States of America, or USA for short. These countries are really, really far from us, across big oceans and lands. Iran is saying that it thinks the USA might be getting ready to do something called "strikes." What are strikes? It means sending military planes or rockets to a place. It's like a way of fighting, but we hope they don't do that. The leader of the USA, Mr. Trump, is thinking very carefully about what to do next. He is making big decisions for his country. Everyone hopes they will choose peace. Did you know? The world has nearly 200 countries! Each country has its own special flag, its own leader, and its own special stories. Isn't that amazing? We live in Africa, a continent with many wonderful countries too!

What Does Iran Say?

Iran says, "If the USA does strikes, then we will fight back!" This is called "retaliation." It means if someone does something to you, you do something back to them. But fighting is not a good way to solve problems, is it? When we fight, people can get hurt, and nobody wants that. It's much, much better to talk. When we talk, we use our words. Words are powerful. They can help us understand each other. Imagine if you and your friend are having a disagreement. If you yell or push, it makes things worse. But if you sit down and talk, and really listen to each other, you can usually find a way to be friends again. That's what grown-ups hope for big countries too. We hope they choose to talk things out. Did you know? In many parts of Africa, people love to sit together and talk when there is a problem. It's called a "peace talk" or a "community meeting." They share ideas and listen to everyone to find the best way forward for peace. It's a very wise way!

Who Wants to Help?

Guess what? There's another country that wants to help Iran and the USA talk! This country is called Qatar. Qatar is a friend to both countries, and they really want to help them find a peaceful way. Qatar is like that good friend who says, "Hey, why don't you two just sit down and talk about it?" Qatar is trying very hard to get Iran and the USA to "revive talks." "Revive talks" means to start talking again, or to make the talks strong again. They believe that if leaders from Iran and the USA can sit together and share their worries and ideas, they can find a solution that doesn't involve fighting. It's a very kind thing for Qatar to do, don't you think? Helping friends talk is a wonderful thing. Did you know? Qatar is a country in the Middle East, a part of the world that is very important for many reasons, including oil! They are trying to be a peacemaker, which is someone who helps others stop fighting and make peace. What a super job!

Why is This Important for Us?

Now, you might be thinking, "This is happening so far away! Why should I know about it?" That's a great question! Even though these countries are very far from us in Africa, when big countries have problems, it can make everyone a little bit worried. It can make the world feel a bit shaky. But the good news is that there are many, many people around the world who are working hard for peace. They want all countries to be friends and to solve their problems with words, not with fighting. Peace is so important everywhere. When there is peace, children can go to school, families can be safe, and everyone can play and grow without worry. It's like when everyone in your classroom is friends, and you can all learn and have fun together. That's what we want for the whole world! Did you know? The United Nations is like a super-big club for almost all the countries in the world! They meet to talk about big problems and try to find peaceful solutions for everyone. It's like a giant school assembly for the whole planet!

What Happens Next?

So, what will happen next? We don't know for sure right now. But we really, really hope that Iran and the USA will listen to Qatar and start talking again. We hope their leaders will sit down, share their thoughts, and find a happy, peaceful way forward. Many people are praying for peace and hoping for good news. We will keep watching the news, and we will always share the important parts with you in a way that's easy to understand. Remember, even when things sound a bit scary, there are always good people trying to make things better. And the best way to make things better is almost always to talk. Talking is strong. Talking is wise. Did you know? Even YOU can be a peacemaker in your daily life! When you share your toys, when you listen to your friends, or when you use kind words to solve a small argument, you are helping to make the world a more peaceful place, one smile at a time!

Let's Keep Hoping for Peace!

So, dear friends, let's all hope that Iran and the USA choose to talk. Let's hope they find a way to be friendly. Because talking is always the best way. It builds bridges, not walls. And when countries talk, everyone wins! We want a world where everyone can live in peace and happiness. Thank you for listening, and remember to always choose kindness and talking in your own lives! See you next time with more news for kids in Africa!
summary: Two big countries, Iran and the USA, are having a disagreement, and another country, Qatar, is helping them talk so they can find a peaceful way forward instead of fighting.
whyMatters: It's important because when big countries talk instead of fight, the world is a safer and happier place for everyone, including us, even though it's happening far away.

originalTitle: 'Constant bombardment' - Fans shown 65,000 junk food ads at World Cup
title: Big Football, Big Ads, and Healthy Choices!
content:
Hey Little Champions! Let's Talk Football!

Hello, amazing boys and girls! Do you love football? Kicking a ball with your friends, running super fast, and cheering for your favourite team? Football is so much fun! This summer, many people around the world watched a very, very big football party called the World Cup. It was a time when teams from different countries played exciting games. Everyone loved watching the players run, score goals, and celebrate. It was a big screen full of action and joy for many weeks!

What Are Adverts, Anyway?

When you watch TV or look at a magazine, sometimes you see pictures or short videos that tell you about something to buy. These are called "adverts" or "ads." Adverts are like little messages that companies send to you. They want to show you their products, like a new toy, a sweet drink, or a crunchy snack. They make these things look super cool and delicious, so you will want to ask your parents to buy them. It's their way of saying, "Look at my yummy food!" or "Come play with my amazing toy!"

Lots and Lots of Ads at the Big Game!

Now, imagine watching your favourite football team at the World Cup. While you were watching the game, or during the breaks, lots of adverts popped up on the screen. New information tells us that people saw adverts for foods and drinks that are not very healthy for a very, very long time. Can you guess how long? It was like watching these adverts for almost 28 whole hours! That's more than a whole day of just watching ads for sugary drinks and fried snacks! Imagine watching adverts for nearly 28 hours – that’s a lot of pictures and videos trying to make you want certain things. It’s like a constant stream of messages filling the screen.

What is "Junk Food"?

So, what exactly are these "unhealthy" foods and drinks? We sometimes call them "junk food." These are things like fizzy drinks with lots of sugar, packets of salty crisps, yummy-looking chocolates, and fried snacks. They taste really good, don't they? But they don't have many good things (like vitamins and minerals) that your body needs to grow big and strong. Eating them sometimes as a special treat is okay. But eating them all the time is not very good for your body. Your body needs strong fuel, like a car needs good petrol!

Why Are Too Many Junk Food Ads Not So Good?

When you see so many adverts for junk food, your brain starts to think, "Oh, that looks so tasty! I really want one!" It can make you feel hungry for those things, even if you are not really hungry. These adverts are very clever! They show happy people eating these snacks, making it look like you will be happy too if you eat them. But if children eat too many sugary drinks and salty snacks, they might not feel their best. They might feel tired, or not have enough energy to play football or run around. Too much sugar is not good for your teeth either, making them weak.

Our Bodies Need Good Fuel!

Think of your body as a super-powered car or a speedy runner. To run fast, jump high, and think clearly in school, your body needs good fuel. What is good fuel? It’s things like fresh fruits, crunchy vegetables, yummy whole grains like maize or rice, and lean proteins like beans or fish. These foods give you lots of energy, help your body grow, and keep you healthy. Eating healthy foods helps you concentrate in school and become a super soccer player! It helps you get strong bones and muscles.

Did You Know? Fun Facts About Food and Fun!

* **Did you know?** An apple has natural sugar that gives you energy, and it also has fibre to help your tummy work well! It’s like a natural energy bar. * **Did you know?** Drinking plain water is super important! Your body is mostly water, and it needs water to help you think, play, and stay cool, especially when you are running around. * **Did you know?** Eating a rainbow of fruits and vegetables means eating many different colours, like red tomatoes, green spinach, and orange carrots. Each colour gives your body different special powers! * **Did you know?** To be a great football player, you need to practise and eat good food. Even famous football stars eat lots of healthy meals to stay strong and fast! They know that healthy food is their secret weapon. * **Did you know?** Running and playing for just one hour can make your heart strong and help you sleep better at night. So, go outside and play!

What Can We Do? Be Smart Superstars!

So, what can we do when we see all these adverts? We can be smart superstars! 1. **Understand the adverts:** Remember, adverts want you to buy things. They make unhealthy foods look super special. But you know that real special food is the healthy kind! 2. **Choose wisely:** When you are hungry, try to choose a fruit like a banana or an orange, or some nuts, or a healthy homemade snack instead of something from an advert. 3. **Talk to your parents:** Tell your mum or dad about what you learned. You can ask them to help you choose healthy snacks when you go shopping. They can help you make good food choices for your family. 4. **Play more:** The more you play and run around, the more energy you use. This also makes your body strong and helps you want healthy foods.

Let's Choose Health!

It’s okay to have a sweet treat or a fizzy drink sometimes, as a special, small amount. But remember, your body is like a temple, and you need to take good care of it! By understanding adverts and choosing more healthy foods, you can be a strong, smart, and super energetic child. You can run faster, jump higher, learn better, and play more football! Let's all make good choices and be healthy champions, just like our favourite football heroes! Keep playing, keep learning, and keep eating your yummy, healthy food!
summary: Fans watching the big World Cup football games saw many, many adverts for unhealthy foods and drinks, which can make it harder for kids to choose healthy snacks.
whyMatters: This is important because seeing lots of ads for sugary drinks and fried snacks can make children want to eat more of them, but eating too much junk food can make it hard to play, learn, and grow strong.
